## Hypothesis

The shotgun scalper stage2 grinder found 5 keepers by relaxing gates and focusing on winning regions. The top keeper uses tight stops (30% premium loss) and quick profits (50% premium gain) with OTM-2 strikes and volume filtering. We hypothesize this captures short-term mean reversion in OTM options premium during intraday pullbacks, but the negative edge_capture (-36.0) indicates it loses on J's source-of-truth bearish rejection days while profiting on other days — suggesting overfit to non-J market regimes.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Trigger when volume ratio > 1.2 (current bar volume / 20-bar average volume) AND premium-based conditions (implicit from shotgun scalper logic).  
**Exit:**  
- Take profit at +50% premium gain (tp_premium_pct=0.5)  
- Stop loss at -30% premium (stop_premium_pct=-0.3)  
- Time stop at 10 minutes (time_stop_min=10)  
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at +50% favor (chandelier_arm_pct=0.5)  
- Strike selection: OTM-2 puts (strike_offset=2)
